claim: During review of the peer-discovery infrastructure, an EndpointSlice-watching approach (heavier RBAC) and a DNS/headless-service approach were both proposed and passed over in favor of direct Pod watching -- indicating the llm-d-router maintainers' peer-discovery design has stayed Kubernetes-primitive-centric across all three iterations considered.
stance_target: report's finding that no non-k8s discovery plugin exists or is under active design discussion
scope_conditions: llm-d-router PR #2341 review discussion, referenced in PR #2501
quoted_support: we also explored watching EndpointSlices to populate the peer list (requiring RBAC changes), but it was suggested to reconsider during review. Alternative approaches were proposed, including DNS queries (requiring a headless service); we propose an alternative that does not require changes in RBAC or Service config.
